title: Paperless Reduction on Residential Electricity Supply Renewal Rates
content:
Residential Electricity Supply renewal rates carry a paperless reduction tied to how the agreement was enrolled and how its notices are delivered.

**Rule.** When the agreement was enrolled through the web and at least one notice on the agreement was delivered by email the full paperless reduction of 0.10 cents per kWh applies; when exactly one of those two holds the partial paperless reduction of 0.05 cents per kWh applies; when neither holds none applies.

| Enrolled through the web | At least one notice on the agreement delivered by email | Paperless reduction (cents per kWh) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.10 |
| yes | no | 0.05 |
| no | yes | 0.05 |
| no | no | none |

**Records read.** The enrollment channel recorded on the agreement and the delivery channel of each notice recorded on the agreement, of any notice type.

**Example (hypothetical).** An agreement enrolled by mail whose notices have all been mailed receives none; had it been enrolled on the web, with the same mailed notices, it would receive 0.05 cents per kWh.
